description: A wave shaper and distortion with a wet and dry balance, working on one or two channels.

params.text: How much the WET jack moves that balance.
Balance between the untreated signal and the shaped one.
How hard the signal is pushed into the wave shaper.
How much the SHAPE jack moves the wave shaping.
How much distortion is added after the shaping.
How much the DISTO jack moves the distortion.

Sets how the two channels are used: up shapes left and right separately, middle drives the two channels' modulation in opposite directions, down shapes IN 1 alone and places it across the stereo pair.

inputs.text: Moves the distortion, by as much as the MOD knob beside DISTO allows.
Moves the wave shaping, by as much as the MOD knob beside SHAPE allows.
Takes the shaper out of circuit while it is high, passing the inputs through untouched.
Moves the wet and dry balance, by as much as the MOD knob beside DRY/WET allows.
Audio into the shaper, left side.
Audio into the shaper, right side, or the stereo position when the switch is down.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
